content.en: Author business/overview/index.yaml with businessOverview for readable purpose, customer understanding, outcome, scope and open questions. Author the sole detailed SRS in extensions.work3.specification using starci/specification@2 on cohesive business/srs/**/index.yaml leaves. Intermediate folders are metadata-only aggregates; scale by adding folders, not editing a registry or duplicating a monolithic SRS. Stable FR/BR/NFR/flow/AC IDs and explicit core refs/dependsOn provide traceability. Do not repeat the detailed SRS in a compact business object. Preserve canonical user journeys and never turn internal service hops into UI actions.
Record requirement-to-acceptance coverage, concrete source observations and unresolved contradictions; a specification review is not implementation evidence.

Only for a selected job matrix, return the exact request-bound result. Populate every declared cell output with actual canonical Work/source/runtime references or produced JSON artifacts from this job; retain real artifact bytes and hashes. Do not rename/regenerate upstream expectations. Missing required output/evidence remains blocked or failed and cannot advance. The selected request freezes output field schemas before execution.

action.en: Resolve the canonical .starciwork workspace and selected business leaf. Research accepted intent, domain documents and current FE/BE callers at exact revisions. Classify every citation as accepted intent, observed source, proposal or unknown; source behavior never approves policy. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers.

Write purpose, scope/exclusions, glossary, assumptions, actors with responsibilities/rights/restrictions, FR/BR and observable NFRs. Specify business data attributes, validation, sensitivity, states/transitions and external inputs/outputs/errors. State why a data or external-interface inventory is empty. Source observations and supplied technical constraints are not approved business policy; unknown numeric targets retain a decision owner.

Every FR resolves to a detailed flow, not a title alone: trigger, primary/supporting actors, inputs, preconditions, numbered actor/request/system-response steps, guards, effects, failures, repeat behavior and success/failure postconditions. Alternative and exception branches identify their starting step, condition, ordered steps, resume/end and acceptance. Review denied/invalid input, cancellation, duplicate/retry, concurrency and recovery where relevant; explain absent branch classes without fabricating cases.

Review observable outcomes against accepted intent and observed behavior. Business states what users and the system must do, not class inheritance, repositories, service placement, Saga/CQRS, Kubernetes or backup tooling. Preserve genuinely supplied technical constraints as sourced external constraints; hand implementation questions to Architecture instead of encoding an invented design in requirements.

Specify actor-action-resource permissions, tenant/owner boundaries, sensitive-data handling and abuse cases. Give each security requirement an observable denial/no-side-effect acceptance scenario; do not mistake a disabled UI control for server enforcement.

Validate detailed requirement/flow/branch/acceptance coverage and the recursive Work graph. Review contradictions, scope and unresolved decisions with the user. A complete branch rolls up only from valid required leaves; draft placeholders and schema validity cannot earn done. Output reviewed business outcomes and observable security/quality acceptance for Architecture; no implementation or deployed-proof claim. Return the selected matrix's request-bound typed outputs when applicable.

requirement.en: Run workspace validation; every cited ID/path exists or is explicitly proposed, required assertions are covered, input bindings are current, and an honest not-run/fail cannot earn done.
Each applicable FR/NFR/BR has acceptance IDs and source intent; no vague fast/secure/user-friendly NFR is accepted as measurable. Implementation/UAT status is untouched.

Every FR has a detailed actor flow and acceptance, every alternative/exception has ordered steps and postconditions, and security has observable negative acceptance. Validate nested ownership and version-2 SRS; no code/service inventory is required in Business.

condition.en: A required rule, actor permission, numeric target or acceptance result has no authoritative decision.
Accepted sources conflict; preserve both citations and ask the actual owner, never average them.

A declared prerequisite is not effectively done, or a required declared input/scope is missing. Report node/resource IDs and propose a separately selected graph update when needed; never run predecessors or weaken dependsOn/refs/required to proceed.

content.en: Write target ownership, call chain, contracts, data ownership and context-relevant controls, observations and gaps. Full starci/specification@2 records the source-grounded design and architectureReview. Patterns are optional and justified; do not require Saga/CQRS for every module. Preserve accepted Business outcomes and distinguish design proof from running behavior.
Record observed current source map and compatibility checks; selected alternative/risk review is design proof, not a passing runtime.

action.en: Research exact FE/BE revisions, manifests, entrypoints, DI, API handlers, data stores, jobs, deploy topology and tests. Follow inbound callers and outbound consumers; cite repository/path/symbol/revision and distinguish observed paths from proposed paths. Trace each network hop from caller symbol through URL/config resolution, proxy/ingress wiring, receiving handler and deployment owner; record synchronous, async and in-process edges separately. Names and comments are clues, not endpoint proof. Keep observed and desired routing separate and block contradictory boundary decisions. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers.

Map accepted business flow and AC IDs to responsible services and authoritative data writers. Draw the logical request/response and asynchronous event sequence in ordered flow rows, including trust boundaries; never assume a class is an independently deployed service. Write ordered serviceCalls with caller/callee service IDs, caller/receiver source refs, operation, endpoint binding, credentials/trust boundary, data classification, timeout/retry and evidence status. Verify response path and downstream side effects. Unobserved deployment/runtime facts remain unknown.

Choose the smallest design satisfying accepted invariants and actual constraints. Challenge one coherent proposal with a materially simpler alternative, trade-offs and a reasoned decision. Select concerns from real business risks, data value, scale, trust boundaries and operating model, not a universal technology checklist. Evaluate named patterns only when relevant; patternDecisions may be empty. An adopted Saga/CQRS/outbox must describe actual mechanisms, not labels or handler filenames. Specify applicable transaction, idempotency, ordering, timeout, concurrency and recovery behavior; never invent numeric targets or unresolved product policy.

Write codeImpacts with exact repository/path/symbol, observed/proposed identity, direct/transitive relation, change/preserve/review decision, reason, caller chain, tests and protected paths. Write serviceImpacts with deployable owner, inbound/outbound consumers, stores/events, compatibility, rollout/rollback and observability; explain unaffected boundaries. Map every selected pattern and service call back to exact source symbols, data/event schemas, deployment/config owners and protected paths. Do not route traffic to a different service merely because its repository contains a matching resolver.

Review each trust boundary: authentication, object/tenant authorization, validation, credential custody, sensitive logs, external provider/AI input, replay and resource abuse where relevant. Link threat, server-side control owner, code/service impact and positive/negative AC. Record residual risks and decision owner without claiming a security audit ran. Add a threat model per trust boundary: assets, entry points, attacker capability, exploit path, impact, prevention/detection, control owner and negative acceptance. Assess object/function/property authorization, tenant isolation, token issuer/audience/scope and forwarding, SSRF/redirect/DNS/egress, injection, webhook authenticity/replay, resource/AI cost abuse, sensitive transcripts/logs and dependency risks when applicable. Mark non-applicability with evidence; unresolved high-impact risks need a decision owner and block acceptance.

Produce implementation ceilings, protected paths, dependencies and required checks from actual repository scripts/CI. Lint, typecheck, tests/coverage, build and Sonar execute inside FE/BE implement; this op specifies them only. Bind rollout/migration/cleanup plans without executing them. Preserve business expected results unchanged. Design failure-injection tests for wrong service target, unauthorized forwarding, stale reads, duplicate/out-of-order messages, crash after commit before publish, compensation failure and retry exhaustion as applicable; implementations run them. Author canonical user journeys and journeyCoverage links to flow/AC IDs using the shared journey contract; preserve accepted journeys unchanged in architecture. Do not convert internal service hops into UI actions. Browser-free scope may use an empty array only when no UAT acceptance is assigned. Record architectureReview with context-selected concerns linked to requirements, sources, concrete trigger/impact/control/owner/acceptance scenarios, decisions, residual risks and evidence limitations. Examine persistence, connections, failure domains, capacity, security, HA, backup/restore, provider or total-infrastructure loss only to the depth their consequences require in this scope. Where durable customer state is in scope, identify authoritative versus rebuildable data, all stores/volumes/config/Secrets/keys, consistency point, independent backup custody, recovery prerequisites/order and verification. Never claim every possible edge case is covered or a recovery drill ran from design prose. Current external production practices need primary sources and an explicit applicability argument.

Validate target ownership, request/data/credential paths, contracts and applicable failure controls against accepted Business and actual sources. Separate proposed design from observations and implementation gaps. Require accepted decisions for material concerns and residual risks before passing design review. Omit unnecessary Saga/CQRS designs; validate concrete mechanisms when selected. Preserve accepted SRS requirements/flows/AC and user journeys, with explicit business leaf dependencies. Architecture done means reviewed design only, never implementation, security audit, HA or executed restore proof.

requirement.en: Run workspace validation; every cited ID/path exists or is explicitly proposed, required assertions are covered, input bindings are current, and an honest not-run/fail cannot earn done.
Every selected operation has an owner, actual/proposed repo-path scope and test instrument; every required business outcome maps to a contract. No source implementation claim.

Every selected flow resolves cited code/service impact, security controls and acceptance; proposed/unknown facts remain explicit. Validate the JSON specification and .starciwork before review completion.

condition.en: An operation/store has no determined owner or required write crosses another owner without scope.
A required version, contract or migration compatibility claim lacks evidence.

goal.en: Produce and inspect one business-grounded visual direction by default; create multiple alternatives only when the user explicitly requests a comparison or choice.

Read exact brand/source assets, surface anatomy, current design system, imagery rights/provenance and accepted references; consult available image/design skill when used.

reads.path: knowledge/INDEX.json + applicable UI composition/presentation and actual installed family topics

purpose.en: Before drawing, read applicable composition, presentation and family knowledge together with the resolved package described by the grammar input. Neither knowledge snapshots nor npm source alone is sufficient for a Grammar-bound design: knowledge explains composition/ownership; the actual package and active family determine available anatomy and styling. Accepted appearance cannot invent API behavior, bypass security or contradict business.

reads.path: consuming app manifest/lockfile + resolved component package exports/types/renderers/CSS + app family root/style imports

purpose.en: Resolve the UI package from the actual consuming app/importer, honoring workspace aliases and bundler resolution; do not assume a monorepo-root node_modules copy is the same version. Record package identity, version, resolved path and inspected file hashes/anchors. Inspect public exports, prop types, renderer anatomy and shipped CSS, then the app's active family root, imported styles and overrides. Trace each used semantic token to the selector/variable/fallback the renderer actually consumes; a similarly named family variable is not proof it is wired. Common component imports do not imply the Core palette or family. No install, upgrade or package edit is authorized by inspection. For a genuinely unbound greenfield design, record not applicable/proposed; unavailable required package or family remains an explicit gap, never a fabricated npm match.

content.en: Write the selected UI direction to one or more approved UI scope nodes at module/ui/index.yaml or recursively below ui/, following schemas/work-layout.json. Each node may cover multiple screens, states, steps and viewports; split only when useful. Record a compact region-to-component map in existing ui.observations or namespaced extensions: screen/state/region, exported component and props, label/body/band anatomy, geometry/paint owner, effective tokens/fallbacks, applicable knowledge rules, source references and unresolved gaps. App-owned regions remain explicit; do not wrap every region in a card. All design files belong under their owning node assets/** and every ui.assets path is also declared in top-level assets for byte binding.

writes.path: E/manifest.yaml + E/direction.png or actual requested format + E/prompt.txt + E/visual-review.md

content.en: Retain actual generated/drawn image and tool provenance, the full prompt including mapped component anatomy and effective family constraints, inspected fidelity findings and separate asset identities. Review against the region-to-component map, not generic attractiveness alone. Distinguish a generated preview from a screenshot of actual components; a generated drawing proves neither exact CSS/token fidelity nor product behavior.

Only for the selected named workflow, emit the response defined by workflows/contracts.json. Return outputs.draws as the full reviewed image array with artifact IDs and screen/state/viewport mapping. A failed/blocked response preserves evidence with outputs:null.

Store any number of generated or accepted design files under each selected UI node assets/** in their actual formats. Names and grouping follow the represented experience, not fixed desktop.png/mobile.png slots. Describe each file role/provenance and its screen/state/viewport coverage in index.yaml. Asset folders need no index.yaml. Keep one shared owner instead of duplicate copies; consumer nodes use refs to that owner. Do not place design files under frontend implementation or UAT; those own running-page captures.
Emit the reviewed draw mapping as readable YAML beside the UI node; image bytes remain in N/assets.

action.en: Freeze the selected brief and content/region mapping, labelling placeholder/example copy. Choose a code-native/vector or raster medium matching the request; do not force ImageGen where not appropriate. Map the canonical accepted journeys and required screens/states/viewports to the complete planned draws array. Ground existing components in source; greenfield surfaces remain proposed. Check architecture service/API boundaries before representing actions. Own the screen/content plan inside this draw job: specify shell, responsive states, truthful landing-page claims, region and asset ownership, motion/accessibility constraints and transitions before producing images. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers. Identify reusable and missing visual assets in the direction. Codex working profiles may use an actually available image generator. Claude may render code-native layouts and reserve blank decorative artwork slots with briefs for later drawing; never claim missing raster artwork was generated. Actual reviewed layout images are still required by the draw output contract.

Create one recommended visual direction by default, not an unsolicited A/B/C set. Only an explicit user request for alternatives, comparison or choice permits multiple directions; honor the requested count (for example two or three), and clarify the count before generation if unspecified. A generic design/improvement request or approval of an assistant-invented alternatives plan does not by itself request extra directions. Required screens, states and desktop/mobile views of the same direction are coverage, not competing alternatives; produce only the images needed for that coverage. Freeze the region-to-component map before image production and carry its actual anatomy, geometry, typography, state and family constraints into the drawing prompt or code-native preview. Do not draw a generic concept first and leave FE to retrofit Grammar afterward. Use the available appropriate tool/skill and retain actual output and provenance. When exact component fidelity is requested, render the actual installed components in an authorized isolated preview; if unavailable, report the limitation instead of certifying a generated approximation. Missing tool means blocked output, never a claimed generated image.

Open and inspect actual output for business contradictions, hierarchy, component ownership, legibility, responsive feasibility and each independent asset. Compare each mapped region against the resolved renderer: label inside/outside the body as actually styled, joined bands versus inset content, separators versus outlines/shadows, typography, status treatment and active family tokens. Distinguish subjective judgement from measured geometry. Review every image against applicable knowledge and mapped journey states; record actual coverage and unresolved conflicts. A material Grammar mismatch must be revised or reported as a gap, not passed as an implementation detail for FE to fix. A user's visual acceptance does not prove npm/CSS conformance or permit package overrides to match the image. Never pass a mandatory state using an unrelated representative image.

Present the single recommended direction and its rationale by default; do not add an alternatives vote or generate extra options for the user to eliminate. Reuse an accepted choice. Ask for selection only when the user explicitly requested multiple alternatives and selection remains open; ordinary goal/result acceptance still applies. Stop without frontend code. For workflow execution, Return outputs.draws as the full reviewed image array with artifact IDs and screen/state/viewport mapping. Submit the exact response to the coordinator gate; never self-advance. Write E/draws.json for FE delivery in standalone and workflow modes; include every required reviewed image and retain its real artifact bytes. When selected in a job matrix, produce E/job-result.json bound to the exact request, its output schema and every required criterion. This handoff is conditional and does not change standalone or named frontend response contracts.

Actual visual bytes opened and reviewed against the brief; dimensions/tool provenance recorded; no UI/UAT pass assigned from the drawing.

Every required journey screen/state has a reviewed image and applicable knowledge review. For a Grammar-bound design, retain the app-resolved package/family evidence, region-to-component map and explicit image comparison against it; package name/version alone or a generic visual pass is insufficient. Unresolved mandatory conflicts block handoff. Generated previews remain previews, not measured component conformance.

purpose.en: For repairs, inspect the original failing assertion and source/runtime revision; reproduce or corroborate it on the current source before changing code. For new implementation record not applicable without inventing a defect.

reads.path: selected UI node index.yaml + its owned assets/*

purpose.en: Receive draws as one ordered array of actual image references, including a one-image array when only one image is supplied; never treat a single scalar or a caption as the array. Record a stable reference, source revision/hash when available, screen, state, viewport and role for each entry in the input map; infer only observable mappings and label unknowns. The selected array is not an alternatives vote: unclear alternatives, approval or contradictory images require a scoped decision. Preserve every entry and its relation to other images; never use only the first image or silently omit inconvenient states. An empty array is allowed only when the selected scope explicitly has no draw input; a missing required array or unreadable image blocks the affected piece. Canonical design refs/files must already be declared where required by the selected graph; report a binding gap rather than changing the graph.

content.en: Read the existing selected scope, expected assertions and .starciwork graph unchanged. Write only state/blocker/completion here; actual observations, findings, commit mappings and remaining cleanup belong to the evidence result, not semantic node prose. Missing refs/dependencies/acceptance require a reported gap or separately selected scope update; never add/remove them to obtain pass.
Only exact owned paths in the approved code-scope, with smallest required caller/integration changes; record actual diff and commit mapping, not proposed changes as delivered.

Retain one draws-review entry per input image with its stable reference, observed screen/state/viewport, inspection result, linked implementation/captures and unresolved gaps; account for every array entry, including explicit non-applicable references with reasons. Retain an input map linking all accepted draws and their regions, business ACs, architecture/API/state contracts and actual source paths; record the applicable knowledge rule IDs/cases, per-rule observations, unresolved conflicts and visual deviations. For repairs retain the original failure, cause, smallest owned repair and before/after regression against unchanged expectations. Retain real test output and screenshot from the implemented surface, actually opened/inspected. Include viewport/theme, observed route/state, driver, served build and limitations; no fixture screenshot labelled product proof. Operator-specific observed result in E/result.md: Map delivered components/routes/client calls to ACs and state coverage; record actual source revision separately from served render revision. This implement op owns lint, typecheck, relevant tests/coverage, affected builds and Sonar. Resolve real repository scripts and CI thresholds; record command, source tree/commit, result and sanitized logs. For Sonar record the analysis/revision and actual server quality-gate result after processing; scanner submission alone is not pass. Fix scoped failures and rerun affected checks. A missing runner, token reference, coverage target or unavailable required Sonar gate is blocked/not-run, never pass; do not move this responsibility to architecture, business or UAT. Reuse existing authorization and keep secrets outside evidence.

Return outputs.flows in the original journey order, preserving business actions/expectations and adding actual sourcePaths; return full codeRefs including accepted backend support commits and the verified rendered runtime. These outputs become UAT inputs unchanged. A failed/blocked response preserves evidence with outputs:null.

Always return the FE handoff JSON, including standalone execution: flows with stable id/title/entry/actor/preconditions, ordered steps {id,action,expected,uxChecks}, cleanup obligations and actual sourcePaths; full codeRefs and observed runtime. Resolve actions and expected results from accepted business scope without weakening them. This is input for uat.verify, not a UAT pass. Use workflows/contracts.json output shape; missing accepted behavior blocks readiness. Include the complete asset manifest; pending decorative artwork stays explicitly deferred. Validate with the selected execution profile and complete input draw IDs.

Do not rename/regenerate upstream expectations. Missing required output/evidence remains blocked or failed and cannot advance. The selected request freezes output field schemas before execution.

Emit the full asset inventory and link ready files to source paths and actual retained image artifacts. Reuse matching existing assets; otherwise generate/create and inspect them with the actual permitted instrument, then integrate dimensions, responsive variants, alt text and loading behavior. For Claude without image generation, keep decorative slots blank with stable layout, no broken/empty src, and a deferred brief {prompt,width,height,format,placement,placeholder:blank-reserved-slot}. Deferred files/artifacts are null, never generated. Do not defer an asset necessary for business/UX acceptance; retain that unmet criterion. When replacing deferred assets later, update source, manifest, commit and affected render checks.

action.en: Collect the selected scope, business ACs, architecture/API contracts, current source and applicable knowledge. Validate draws as an array and open every image; index each by actual screen/state/viewport and source identity in draws-review and the input map. Resolve shared layouts, responsive variants, sequential states and ambiguous alternatives explicitly. For repairs reproduce the original defect and preserve its evidence. Own preparation through delivery: inspect readiness and reproduce the requested defect when applicable, partition the selected work into cohesive changes and check callers before editing. Resolve repository-local dependencies and bounded development runtime needs under the existing scope. Shared library changes belong to the actual FE or BE package owner: include owner tests, packaging/export compatibility and selected consumer integration proof in this same implementation; never publish a package implicitly. Keep shared paths exclusive and report a missing required external authority rather than inventing a helper. For a landing surface, implement the accepted content, section sequence, assets and responsive interaction in the selected frontend source. Draw is only needed when the request requires a new visual decision; do not add a mandatory planning predecessor. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers.

Map every relevant region across all draws to routes, shared/owned components, API reads/actions, states, ACs and actual knowledge rules/cases. Business governs behavior; images express accepted visual intent within applicable knowledge and installed component constraints. Record missing screens/states and cross-image or knowledge conflicts; do not average incompatible alternatives, invent behavior from pictures or weaken the selected graph.

Implement the mapped screens and shared layout once using actual installed components, tokens and repository conventions. Apply scoped creation, refinement or the smallest defect repair; retain cross-image consistency, responsive behavior, keyboard and focus. Follow applicable knowledge even where literal image copying would violate it; unresolved material design conflicts remain blocked. Account for every asset visible in every input draw. Reuse a verified matching asset or create/generate the required asset, inspect it and integrate its actual source file. Claude with no image-generation capability may reserve a blank decorative slot with a deferred brief; never use invented URLs, broken images or label pending art complete. Functional asset requirements remain blocking. Record E/assets.json even when the reviewed draws need no distinct assets. Write the frontend source summary only to implementation/frontend/index.yaml. Store only running-page screenshots in implementation/frontend/assets; design PNGs remain in ui/assets and UAT captures remain with their flow.

Connect actual data reads/actions, validation, permissions and navigation for the mapped journeys. Implement applicable loading, empty, error, denied, success and recovery states from the accepted business/API contracts, including required states not depicted in draws. Never guess endpoints, fake success or invent undisclosed business decisions. CALL POINT (step 4): if an observed API integration or render-data defect blocks an already accepted journey and is repairable without business changes, read interface.implement/secondary.json and call its listed backend.implement role. Pass the exact backend repository, allowed file paths, defect evidence/problem, changeKind and unchanged businessRefs. Set FE to waiting in this same cell. If no such defect exists, skip this call. If the repair needs business/schema/authorization changes or an unlisted operator, return blocked with the missing decision. Resume this step only after every required support response matches its request and passes every required criterion in the caller-owned secondary.json, including scope, business preservation, API compatibility, implementation quality and commit verification; inspect returned changes, integrate the actual commits and continue to step 5. Defects discovered in steps 5 or 6 return to this call point under the same permissions; never create an implicit helper.

Run relevant component/unit, interaction, type, lint and build checks for mapped ACs/states and applicable knowledge. For repairs retain before/after evidence for the original unchanged expected assertion plus collateral regressions. Fix only within scope; keep failed or untested required behavior visible. This implement op owns lint, typecheck, relevant tests/coverage, affected builds and Sonar. Resolve real repository scripts and CI thresholds; record command, source tree/commit, result and sanitized logs. For Sonar record the analysis/revision and actual server quality-gate result after processing; scanner submission alone is not pass. Fix scoped failures and rerun affected checks. A missing runner, token reference, coverage target or unavailable required Sonar gate is blocked/not-run, never pass; do not move this responsibility to architecture, business or UAT. Reuse existing authorization and keep secrets outside evidence.

Bind an authorized preview and observed served build. Open the implemented screens, drive relevant controls and capture every required screen/state/viewport represented by draws plus other required acceptance states. Open the captures and compare each mapped draw with its corresponding rendered evidence and applicable knowledge rules. Record coverage per input image and all deviations; no representative screenshot may stand in for unobserved screens. Repair within scope and recheck affected tests/captures before passing.

Review the owned diff and complete draws/AC/state/rule coverage; account for every input image and preserve justified out-of-scope limitations without silently dropping requirements. Record actual code commits when authorized, tested/served revisions, evidence and remaining gaps. Complete only when required implementation and rendered proof pass. Independent full UAT remains separate; stop. For workflow execution, Return outputs.flows in the original journey order, preserving business actions/expectations and adding actual sourcePaths; return full codeRefs including accepted backend support commits and the verified rendered runtime. These outputs become UAT inputs unchanged. Submit the exact response to the coordinator gate; never self-advance. Create the scoped local commit under the existing implementation authority after required checks pass, read back full SHA and committed diff, and return per-repository commit references. Preserve unrelated local changes; never stage everything, bypass hooks, push or invent an empty commit. If no code changed, return the verified existing commit and explain no change. Missing commit proof prevents a passing delivery. Always write E/flows.json as the ready UAT handoff, even outside a named workflow; preserve accepted journey order and expected results, bind source paths, real commits and the observed served build. Validate with validateFEHandoff against the selected accepted journeys before delivery. When selected in a job matrix, produce E/job-result.json bound to the exact request, its output schema and every required criterion. This handoff is conditional and does not change standalone or named frontend response contracts. Include assets in E/flows.json and FE outputs alongside flows/codeRefs/runtime; pass the exact manifest to UAT. The assets-accounted-for criterion requires full draw coverage and real ready assets or explicitly allowed decorative deferrals.

After both gates pass, run required lint, typecheck, coverage, build and Sonar checks against the same source revision. Preserve failures, repair only within the approved goal, rerun affected gates, and never delegate this responsibility to frontend or UAT.

Review the diff and verify no unrelated changes. A passing backend delivery requires scoped unit and backend E2E evidence, every applicable quality gate, the exact tested source tree, API contract, authorization/error behavior, and runtime identity when the consumer requires a runnable API. Commit only when authorized, then read back the full SHA/diff and prove the tested tree corresponds to that commit; otherwise report uncommitted or no-change honestly. Missing or not-run unit/E2E proof, commit mismatch, or unavailable required served runtime blocks the handoff, so frontend cannot consume it as verified backend. Never bypass hooks, push, stage unrelated files or invent proof.

This operator owns separate scoped unit and backend E2E gates plus lint, typecheck, coverage, affected builds and Sonar. Evidence records command, environment, tested source tree/full commit, exit and counts for each gate. Backend E2E must exercise the actual backend boundary and cannot be replaced by frontend browser UAT. Scanner submission without the processed server result, a missing runner/token/dependency, or any not-run required gate is blocked rather than pass.

Reuse is the first choice, never reset a shared password. Planned identity slots must already be in selected scope; write actual provider IDs only after observing creation. Preserve reused accounts and record whether a new account is disposable or explicitly retained.

Inspect reusable seed SQL, cleanup SQL and resource-management scripts and the real APIs they call. Create missing scripts inside the selected automation source scope from the actual schema/SDK/API. Keep test plumbing separate from product repairs. Record script versions and use sealed credentials at execution time, never in tracked source or evidence.

This is not unlimited unrelated spending or an invitation to retry forever. Discover deletion and post-delete verification capability before creating billable resources.

Require a stable run ID, exact recorded IDs, environment/account ownership checks, dry-run/plan inspection, parameterized SQL, transactions where supported, idempotent cleanup and nonzero failure exits. Do not modify business code, expected outcomes, database schema or apply production migrations.

fields: details: actual IDs and sealed refs only

Finalize semantic IDs, revisions and custody refs before computing the verification input digest. content.en: Keep request flow order, original assertion IDs, actual locators/actions and business results, per-check expected yes/no and observed yes/no, screenshots and playable real browser video indexed by flow/step/time. For unobserved checks keep actual null with not-run/inconclusive outside the yes/no answer column. Record stable run ID, reused versus created objects, immediate returned resource IDs, provider correlation IDs, script hashes/commands/exits, before/after read-back and cleanup ownership/results. A screenshot or silent video alone cannot prove a business outcome. Redact credentials, PII and sensitive video frames; hash the final sanitized playable assets. Operator-specific observed result in E/result.md: Preserve expected flows and business assertions; keep per-flow outcomes, yes/no UX observations, original failures and cleanup results in evidence. Done requires the selected journeys and required cleanup to pass.

Only for the selected named workflow, emit the response defined by workflows/contracts.json. Return outputs.results for every input flow and step in order, yes/no UX observations and screenshot/video evidence, plus outputs.cleanup with no unresolved owned resources for a pass. A failed/blocked response preserves evidence with outputs:null.

Only for a selected job matrix, return the exact request-bound result. Populate every declared cell output with actual canonical Work/source/runtime references or produced JSON artifacts from this job; retain real artifact bytes and hashes. Do not rename/regenerate upstream expectations. Missing required output/evidence remains blocked or failed and cannot advance. The selected request freezes output field schemas before execution.

action.en: Freeze the requested flows order, business expectations and applicable UX checks before effects. UX answers are yes/no for observed loading feedback, error feedback, skeleton, validation, retry/recovery and completion as requested; no beauty, spacing, color, typography or visual-fidelity scoring. Specify expected yes or no and applicability before running; a skeleton is not universally required and no error on a happy path is not automatically a failure. Verify runtime/served identity and actual screenshot/video capability before starting. Own case preparation within this invocation: map every requested flow and step to accepted ACs, actor, entry, preconditions, feedback, persistent read-back where required, real screenshot/video checkpoints and cleanup obligations before effects. Locator choices never redefine expected behavior. No plan/account/seed predecessor is required. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers. Read the FE asset manifest and preserve explicit deferred artwork status. Test business/UX expectations only; cosmetic artwork may remain pending under the accepted profile policy, but missing assets required by a requested flow cannot satisfy its criteria.

Inspect or author the missing seed/delete/resource-management scripts from actual owners. Review dry-run targets and failure behavior, test their guards without destructive product effects, and prepare a finally-style cleanup path before the first mutation. The run ledger records reused baselines and every created/mutated ID immediately; discover unknown provider outcomes by read-only correlation before retries.

Reuse a suitable account or create the authorized scoped account through its supported provider/script; verify actual login, role and membership. Resolve credentials at use time and isolate browser sessions for distinct actors while retaining the session continuity each sequential flow requires. Track disposable account ownership separately from reused identities.

Execute reviewed parameterized seed SQL only for missing prerequisites, recording exact inserted IDs and before-images for any authorized changes to reused records. Verify preconditions by read-back. Finalize identity/fixture metadata and compute the actual verification digest before starting the tested journeys; never seed a successful outcome or fabricate a passing prerequisite.

Run flows[0], flows[1], and so on in the requested order, each action in its declared sequence, with real browser controls and continuous real video per flow. Capture screenshots at significant steps, loading/error/skeleton observations and failure points. Real configured paid AI calls are permitted within the authorized flow; do not substitute mocked AI success. Record asynchronous operation/resource IDs promptly and verify actual completion, not merely request acceptance.

For each reached checkpoint answer observed UX checks yes/no only, linked to screenshot/video timestamps. Verify expected business results through actual response, reload/resume and authorized read-only API/SQL read-back; API writes never perform an action claimed as UI-tested. Preserve failures; dependent later steps are not-run, while independent later flows may proceed only in original order with safe preconditions. Do not repair product code or rewrite expected outcomes inside UAT.

After success, failure or interruption, finalize and inspect the real recordings/screens and run the prepared cleanup for all owned effects. Delete externally provisioned resources through the supported direct provider/API script using exact ledger IDs before removing local metadata; SQL deletion alone cannot delete a VM or stop billing. Poll/reconcile actual absence or provider deletion completion and dependent owned resources. Run cleanup SQL in dependency-safe order, restore authorized reused-record before-images and remove disposable accounts only when owned and selected for cleanup. Preserve shared/reused objects and explicitly retained prerequisites; never broad-delete by age or name prefix alone.

Read back database and provider state to prove cleanup, retaining the ownership ledger, scripts and sanitized evidence. If a resource remains, record exact IDs, costs when observable and an executable resume-cleanup command; incomplete cleanup blocks overall done even when flows passed. Report each flow result, the yes/no UX table, screenshot/video refs, usage/cost observations and cleanup result. Validate bound evidence and stop; never claim the journey succeeded solely because cleanup succeeded. For workflow execution, Return outputs.results for every input flow and step in order, yes/no UX observations and screenshot/video evidence, plus outputs.cleanup with no unresolved owned resources for a pass. Submit the exact response to the coordinator gate; never self-advance. When selected in a job matrix, produce E/job-result.json bound to the exact request, its output schema and every required criterion. This handoff is conditional and does not change standalone or named frontend response contracts.

requirement.en: Run workspace validation; every cited ID/path exists or is explicitly proposed, required assertions are covered, input bindings are current, and an honest not-run/fail cannot earn done.

Every requested flow and action retains its order, real execution status and original expected outcome; dependent unreached steps are not-run and no parallel flow execution is presented as sequential.

Actual rendered controls produced each required business outcome with a passing behavior assertion, verified served version and required persistence/negative checks. Paid AI results are actual provider outcomes, not a fake placeholder.

Each observed applicable UX answer is yes or no with expected value and direct evidence; unobserved checks stay null plus not-run/inconclusive. No appearance score is produced and required failed checks block completion.

Every executed flow has finalized playable genuine video and indexed screenshots for its required checkpoints, verified after redaction. Missing recording cannot be replaced by generated video or stills labelled as footage.

Seed, delete and resource-management scripts are real inspected reusable source with exact environment/run ownership guards and observed exits; setup/cleanup output records actual IDs and failures, not illustrative SQL or fake provider APIs.

Every run-owned created resource/row/account selected for deletion is confirmed absent through its real owner, reused mutations are restored where authorized, and retained objects have explicit ownership reasons. Partial setup, failed flows and uncertain asynchronous effects remain in the cleanup ledger until resolved; unfinished cleanup cannot earn done.

The permitted browser cannot capture required genuine video/screenshots or the final sanitized files cannot be played/read.
An effect exceeds the selected account/data/provider/paid-AI authority or stated spending limits.
